blocks.text: Visual database that powers flexible workflows for modern teams

Airtable sits at the intersection of spreadsheets and databases, offering the familiarity of a grid view with the power of relational data. For startup teams, this means you can build custom tracking systems, CRMs, content calendars, and project management tools - all without writing a line of code.

The real power emerges when you connect Airtable to your automation stack. With native integrations to Zapier, Make, and Slack, your Airtable bases become the central nervous system for your operations. A new form submission can trigger a Slack notification, create a task, and update a dashboard - all automatically.

Airtable's different views (Grid, Kanban, Calendar, Gallery, Gantt) mean the same underlying data can serve multiple teams. Marketing sees a content calendar, engineering sees a Kanban board, and leadership sees a Gantt chart - all looking at the same records.
Grid, Kanban, Calendar, Gallery, Gantt, and Timeline views for the same data
Link records across tables to build proper relational data models
Built-in workflow triggers that run actions when records change
Create intake forms that feed directly into your database
REST API and native integrations with 1000+ tools
Build custom dashboards and internal apps on top of your data
Airtable is the backbone of many automation workflows we build for clients. Its flexibility means it adapts to almost any process, and its API makes it the perfect hub for connecting tools together.
Our team can integrate Airtable into your workflow and automate the repetitive parts.
